FAQs on Generative AI in Retail Generative AI in Retail Industry - Adoption and Usage EY's research suggests that GenAI can increase retail profitability by 20% by 2025. With 71% of Indian retailers planning to adopt GenAI within the next year, EY is well-positioned to guide the industry through this transformative era. Source: www.ey.com/ Generative AI (GenAI) is no longer science fiction for the retail industry. Companies use this powerful AI technology to create content, personalize the customer experience, and improve operational efficiency. Consider AI-powered chatbots that can answer your questions about a product, recommend similar items you might like, and even troubleshoot any issues you encounter during the checkout process – all in a natural and engaging way. This is the potential of GenAI for customer service. Companies like Meta are partnering with advertising agencies to develop such capabilities for Messenger apps, aiming to reduce unanswered customer inquiries significantly. GenAI can also personalize each customer's shopping experience. Amazon's pilot program with Rufus, a shopping assistant powered by GenAI, is a great example. Rufus can scour product catalogs and deliver personalized recommendations based on past purchases and browsing history. This can save you time and help you discover new products you might be interested in. Major Retailers like Walmart are using GenAI to create smarter search functions. These new features allow customers to search for products based on themes or use cases, making it easier to find what you're looking for. Listen to Rajdeep Arora's (Staff Data Scientist @Walmart) insightful podcast, where he talks about the practical applications of Generative AI (GenAI) in the retail industry, extending far beyond conventional uses. He discusses how GenAI is revolutionizing the roles of data scientists, highlighting their evolving responsibilities and the significant potential to streamline and enhance various business processes. The podcast also explores how GenAI is utilized for targeted advertising, personalized customer interactions, and numerous other innovative applications reshaping the retail landscape.
